- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- No functional or documentation changes were made to SKILL.md
- This update only deletes a supplementary file, resulting in a leaner skill package

Initial release of the Frontend Engineer skill.

- Provides a comprehensive frontend, mobile, and UI development guide for web apps, native/cross-platform apps, and game UI.
- Includes a Mode Selector to auto-detect and announce the relevant specialization and tech stack before starting any deliverable.
- Offers detailed best practices and tooling guides for major web frameworks (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte) and mobile/game stacks (React Native, Flutter, Unity, Minecraft plugins).
- Emphasizes built-in accessibility, performance, and testing standards from the outset.
- Clearly defines output standards (typed interfaces, tests, accessibility notes) for all component deliverables.
